cpl.name: HyperGSD Contexts
cpl.title: yan/hypergsd-contexts
cpl.readme:
''HyperGSD Contexts'' is a sub-plugin of [[HyperGSD|$:/plugins/yan/hypergsd]] that adds the //Context// type and has the following benefits:

* Offers easy ways to enter context on GSD tiddlers
* Offers dashboards and grouping mechanisms to look through your actions/projects by context:
** On the [[GSD/Contexts]] dashboard
** On individual contexts you create.

Contexts are ordinary tags, which are in turn tagged with <<tag GSD/Contexts>>.
Being simple tags, context will be automatically inherited when you create actions from a tiddler.

You can add as many contexts as you want to action or project tiddlers.

The plugin also ships with a button in lists that lets you quickly contextualise an action or project.
